headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 30, 2026**
article:
The MLB season continues to heat up with several notable performances and roster moves. Here's a look at the top news from around the league.

Top News
The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-3 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Junior Perez leading the offense with a home run and three RBIs. Erick Fedde earned the win for the White Sox, while Tyler Schweitzer secured the save. The Texas Rangers also secured a hard-fought win over the Cleveland Guardians, with Jacob deGrom leading the charge on the mound. DeGrom pitched 7.0 innings, striking out 9 batters and allowing just 2 earned runs. The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates 8-0, handing them their latest defeat. Trea Turner led the Phillies' offense with a 2-hit, 3-RBI performance, including a 9th home run of the season. The Detroit Tigers secured a decisive victory over the New York Yankees, winning 9-3. Riley Greene led the Tigers' offense with a standout performance, going 2-for-4 with 2 home runs and 3 RBIs.

Injuries and Availability Impact
Several players have been placed on the injured list, including Boston Red Sox left-handed pitcher Connelly Early, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to left elbow inflammation. Other players who have been placed on the injured list include Miami Marlins right-handed pitcher Anthony Bender, Houston Astros shortstop Jeremy Peña, Cincinnati Reds center fielder Dane Myers, Baltimore Orioles left-handed pitcher Keegan Akin, Seattle Mariners designated hitter Rob Refsnyder, Chicago Cubs right fielder Matt Shaw, and Chicago Cubs right-handed pitcher Ethan Roberts.

Trades and Roster Movement
The Boston Red Sox have bolstered their roster with the addition of third baseman Brett Harris, acquired in a trade with the Athletics. Harris joins the Red Sox in exchange for right-handed pitcher Ben Hansen. The Seattle Mariners have also made a trade, acquiring first baseman Buddy Kennedy from the San Francisco Giants in exchange for cash. The Athletics have traded right-handed pitcher Hayden Juenger to the Toronto Blue Jays in exchange for catcher Owen Carapellotti. The Chicago Cubs have traded left-handed pitcher David Peterson to the New York Mets in exchange for third baseman Cole Mathis.
